name: Emergency Contact Button
author: WebEllio

sections.description:
The Emergency Contact Button plugin adds a customizable floating button to your WordPress website. Users can click the button to access quick contact options such as calling, WhatsApp messaging, or emailing.

Key Features:
– Add a floating button to your website.
– Customize the button’s appearance (color, position, size, etc.).
– Add phone, WhatsApp, and email contact options.
– Upload a custom button image or use the default one.
– Fully responsive and mobile-friendly.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the emergency-contact-button folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Emergency Contact Button > General to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I customize the button?

Go to Emergency Contact Button > Style in your WordPress admin dashboard. You can customize the button’s appearance, position, and contact options.

Can I use a custom image for the button?

Yes! You can upload a custom image for the button in the plugin settings.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the floating button is fully responsive and works seamlessly on all devices.
